snippet.title: Sands of Aura | Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Sands of Aura is Available Now on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5 & Nintendo Switch!

Embark on a haunting Soulslike adventure set in a world buried beneath endless sands. As one of the last Remnant Knights, players must cross the vast sandseas aboard a grainwake, battle relentless undead, and uncover secrets that could restore a dying world.

⚔️ Master seven distinct fighting styles
🛡️ Craft thousands of weapons with powerful augmentations
🏝️ Explore island peaks rising above endless dunes
🏰 Rebuild the Starspire and strengthen humanity’s last refuge
🎮 Optimized for consoles with refined systems and targeting assist


Play Today:
